nc.description: A grey, angular helmet rests tilted backwards on a smooth, white spherical head attached to a grey base.

A 3D rendering shows a fluted cylindrical shaft with a tapered end inserted into a slotted rectangular block, with a white ring floating below.
Smooth, grey geometric shapes are arranged in a symmetrical, radiating pattern around a central six-pronged hub on a white surface.

vc.description: A robotic hand grips the threaded end of a cylindrical component attached to another robotic arm.

A grey mechanical assembly features a central toothed gear resting on segmented pads, with two hinged metal arms attached to a central shaft above it.
A grey mechanical assembly featuring a textured handle, threaded components, and a separate base piece is shown with a circular arrow indicating rotational movement on the left end of the shaft.
